09-mockup.note: NEXUS only: NEXUS's design tokens are in design/nexus/, in the Design Tokens Community Group format 2025.10: base.tokens.json, one file for each theme under theme/, and tokens.resolver.json, which chooses between them (drafted on 2026-11-03 while the memory plugin is built, as the maintainer chose on 2026-11-02, on the recommendations of stages 03 to 08, whose joint checkpoint passed on 2026-11-03). Not Figma or Claude Design, the stage's defaults: Figma is not connected to this project, and a page drawn from the tokens keeps a token name in every value and can be measured in a browser. The maintainer chose direction A, Hub pages, on 2026-11-03, the stage's first checkpoint. Its mockups of every state of SCR-101, SCR-104 and SCR-105 to SCR-109 are one page, docs/09-mockup/nexus/mockup.html, explained in docs/09-mockup/nexus/README.md, and looked at as a private published page whose link is in the project's records, not in `link`, since the repository is public. The maintainer passed its second checkpoint, frozen tokens, on 2026-11-03, together with stages 03 to 08, so the tokens are frozen for NEXUS 0.2 before development uses them: a later change needs the maintainer's decision. Translations beside them are not read as sources. Ownership moved to this product repository on 2026-11-04; original decisions remain traceable. The approved runtime is the existing VPS, with Worker compatibility retained.
